title: Tag pace_calculator.dart's TODOs with real DNI-#### Linear ids

evidence.quote: // TODO(Epic-12): Wire this callback into the notification system (DNI notification story).
// TODO(Epic-12): Epic 12 notification system should pass an [onPaceBehind]

why: AG-6 requires every TODO/FIXME to carry a Linear id in `DNI-####` form so it's traceable and greppable; `Epic-12` is not that id (an epic isn't a specific tracked issue). Repo-wide only 4 TODO comments exist in lib/ at all, and none use the DNI-#### format — half of the entire repo's TODO population lives in this one file within my batch.
recommendation: Replace `TODO(Epic-12)` with `TODO(DNI-####)` referencing the actual Linear issue for wiring the notification callback.
acceptance_criteria: Both TODOs reference a real DNI-#### id.
A grep-based Rule-0 checker for `TODO(?!DNI-)` could catch future regressions (currently no such checker exists).
